anchor_sources.citation: Bailey D.H., Borwein J.M., Crandall R.E. (1997). On the Khintchine Constant. Mathematics of Computation 66(217), 417-431.
anchor_sources.section: Appendix: The Khintchine Constant K_0 to 7,350 Digits
anchor_sources.transcription_method: hand-transcribed from the appendix's 50-digit-per-line listing (lines 1-10 = first 500 fractional digits) via pypdf-extracted text

divisor_sentinel.explanation: If the 1/log(2) divisor had been wrongly omitted, log K_0 would be larger by factor ~1.4427, so K_0 itself would be replaced by exp(log(K_0)*log(2)) which is ~4.16 vs the true ~2.685. The sentinel confirms the divisor IS in place: the corrected form (no exponentiation reshuffling) equals the anchor, the uncorrected form (with reshuffling that simulates a missing divisor) does not.
